items.title: Mr. and Mrs. A.C. Synigal Interview, 1962-05-24
items.q: Iris May. Turn around this way. Iris May.

ctx.x: Martinez, yes, yes. This is her son. She's my cousin. This is her son. And this is the one who drives. Louise Bibelet. That's my nephew. And this is Anne Marie. She was the maid this year. From that time, look how she's grown. She was maid this year. That's Anne Marie, Anne Marie Serena. This is Sylvia. And this is my grandson. He's in, he's in, um, in the Air Force Station at San Francisco. Now, this is, um, Iris May. You could help if you come to me. Iris May. Turn around this way. Iris May. I had so many to…
You didn't have it? Oh, that's right there. That's a huge Christmas tree.
